name: ContextMenu
description: A right-click menu that scales in at the pointer inside a dashed target area, clamped and flipped to stay inside the viewport. It supports shortcut hints, separators, group labels, checkbox items with an animated check and a nested submenu, with full keyboard navigation.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA menu pattern: role="menu" panels with menuitem / menuitemcheckbox (aria-checked) rows, role="separator", aria-disabled, and submenu triggers with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded. The target area is focusable and opens the menu with Shift+F10, the ContextMenu key, Enter or Space (focus moves to the first item). Arrow Up/Down move focus (wrapping), Home/End jump, typing a letter jumps to a matching item, Enter/Space activate, Arrow Right opens and Arrow Left closes a submenu, Escape closes the current level and Tab closes everything. Focus returns to the target area on close; outside click, scroll, resize and window blur dismiss. The last action is announced through an aria-live region. Under prefers-reduced-motion the menu only fades.
